answer: In an AI-agent economy, sybil resistance comes from forcing every new identity to whisper a unique one-time commitment derived from a shared mesa of collective bonded stake; that commitment is immediately burned as an irrecoverable ember of value that can only be partially restored after the agent successfully completes multiple independent peer attestations. Consequently an attacker must permanently sacrifice real capital for each fabricated identity, making large-scale sybil creation economically prohibitive.
